title: SPE8ED26Q0257
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY.TROOP SUPPORT CONSTRUCTION & EQUIPMENT.DLA TROOP SUPPORT
detail_text: THIS IS A PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE ONLY. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR QUOTE (RFQ). NO SOLICITATION IS AVAILABLE AT THIS TIME. This solicitation will be under the procedures of Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Overhaul Part 12, as implemented by Class Deviation 2026-O0028, for the anticipated procurement of NSN# 8150-01-463-8553, 20'X8’X8'6" SEA/LAND CARGO CONTAINER, END-OPENING ON ONE END. The solicitation number will be SPE8ED-26-Q-0257. Containers must comply with ISO standards. SURPLUS CONTAINERS WILL NOT BE ACCEPTABLE FOR THIS REQUIREMENT. COLOR: Federal Standard 595 (FED-STD-595/34094 Camo-Green) with ISO markings in white. QUANTITY: Price breaks will be required per clin/location. DESTINATION SHIPPING TO: Blue Grass Army Depot, KY Joint Base Lewis-McChord (JBLM), WA Fort Sill, OK Fort Riley, KS QUOTE SUBMISSION : The DLA Internet Bid Board System (DIBBS) electronic upload is the sole method of quote submission. A copy of the solicitation will be made available via DIBBS, https://www.dibbs.bsm.dla.mil./ DIBBS is a web-based application that provides the capability to search for, view, and submit secure quotes for Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) items of supply. Mailed offers, e-mailed offers, hand-carried offers and facsimile offers are NOT authorized for receipt of quote. A solicitation will not be emailed to interested parties. All interested parties must access SPE8ED-25-Q-0257 via DIBBS. If the offeror is unable to timely upload its proposal in DIBBS, this will not constitute an acceptable excuse to submit a late offer.
